summary: Oil-Dri Corp of America filed an 8-K reporting quarterly results (Item 2.02) and declaring a regular quarterly dividend of $0.225/share on common and $0.168/share on Class B stock, plus authorizing repurchase of up to 500,000 common shares under an existing plan. These are routine operating and capital allocation actions, not a special situation. The board approved these items without any unusual structure, advisor, or premium. No event triggers a special-situations classification.
